name: Louise
text: Well I do not have the words to explain how grateful I am to have found such a caring, loving and knowledgeable dog minder. I have struggled to find an environment that was suitable with having a small and large dog, quite the odd combination, however, Linda put my mind at total ease with regular updates and lovely pictures/videos. As we all know, having fur babies and entrusting them to a new minder is always quite nerve wrecking for us humans. I can hand in heart say dogs speak for themselves, so much so on one collection day Co Co ran back to go with Linda😂 that’s all the confirmation I needed! I could not find the right words to recommend Linda for the service she provides as I don’t believe it exists any where else. Please any one looking for a day minder/holiday stay don’t go to anyone else this is a beautiful caring doggy retreat for them. So we can be at peace while they are enjoying themselves. Thank you agin Linda, see you soon ❤️❤️❤️

name: Sonja
text:
We honestly couldn’t wish for better dog sitters! ❤️🐾

From the very first moment, we had such a wonderful feeling about both of you. You can immediately tell that you don’t simply “look after” dogs,  you welcome them with so much love, patience, care and kindness, and treat them as if they were your own.

For us, it is absolutely priceless to know that our two furry family members are in such loving and trustworthy hands. We were able to completely relax and enjoy our time away without worrying for a single second. The regular updates, photos and messages made us so happy and showed us just how comfortable and happy they were with you. 🥹❤️

The way you both care for them and pay attention to each dog’s individual personality and needs is truly something special. You can genuinely feel that you do this with all your heart.

Thank you so much for your incredible care, your patience, your love, and for making our dogs feel like they have a second home with you. 🐶🐾❤️

For us, there is absolutely no question: whenever we need someone we can trust 100% with our dogs, it will always be you!

We couldn’t recommend you highly enough an absolute recommendation from the bottom of our hearts! ❤️❤️❤️
